0022600108.text: The Wizards (1-1, 5th in the East and second in the Southeast, one game back) are on a one-game losing streak as they visit the Bulls (1-1, 7th in the East and second in the Central, one game back), who have won their last game. Washington is without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (hamstring), and Noa Essengue (head) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Washington lost all three meetings against Chicago in 2025-26, most recently 119-108 in Washington on April 9, 2026.
